# NJ Home Sale Checklist

> NJ Home Sale Checklist is a free guide to the inspections and certificates involved in selling or buying a New Jersey home: the smoke/CO alarm certificate, well testing, radon, oil tanks and lead, with a directory of DCA-certified lead evaluation contractors.

It is for New Jersey sellers, buyers, agents and closing attorneys. Listings: NJ DCA certified lead evaluation contractors (list revised 8/11/2026). NJDEP lists (well-testing labs, radon businesses, UST closure firms) could not be fetched automatically. Those pages link to the official lookup instead. Every page has a Markdown version: replace the trailing slash with `.md` (home: https://njhomesalechecklist.com/index.md).

## Checklist & guides
- [New Jersey Home Sale Checklist: Inspections & Certificates](https://njhomesalechecklist.com/home-sale-checklist/): hub
- [NJ Smoke & CO Alarm Certificate for Home Sales (CSACMAPFEC)](https://njhomesalechecklist.com/smoke-co-certificate/): statewide rules
- [NJ Smoke & CO Certificate by Town](https://njhomesalechecklist.com/smoke-co-certificate/towns/): town pages
- [NJ Private Well Testing Act (PWTA) at Home Sale](https://njhomesalechecklist.com/well-testing/)
- [Radon Testing in a NJ Home Sale](https://njhomesalechecklist.com/radon/)
- [Oil Tanks (USTs) in a NJ Home Sale: Sweeps & Closure](https://njhomesalechecklist.com/oil-tanks/)

## Directory
- [NJ Certified Lead Evaluation Contractors by County](https://njhomesalechecklist.com/lead/): DCA-certified lead evaluation contractors by county
